name: Mugi Bakehouse
description: Mugi Bakehouse — a block theme for a neighbourhood bakery. A greige-white ground, ink and one russet line, with Fraunces over Source Serif 4. The home page opens on a full-bleed film-grain photograph of the bakehouse at 06:15 with two half-ring edge tabs (Oven, Bench) that swap the frame and two outline capsule tabs fixed at the bottom corners, then ruled loaf rows with slanted one-pixel rules and marker chips, the oven day as an hour ledger, a parallax counter photograph, standing orders, three neighbours and the day book. Works without any plugin; WooCommerce compatible.
